project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child acts a short trip: crosses the road safely, counts the passengers, says their name in French in case they get lost and draws a vehicle.

activities.goal_en: Say a travel rhyme with movements.
activities.prompt_en: Let us take the little bus! Say the rhyme and move with me.
steps_en: Say the rhyme with the gestures (steering wheel, wheels).
Repeat line by line.
Say it together, moving in a line like a bus.
Ask: where does the bus go?
source_refs: Nursery One, table 15 (Poetry and Rhymes: Rhymes), p. 40; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.story_en:
Beep, beep, says the little bus,
The wheels go round, there is room for us,
Stop at the market, stop at the school,
Sit down quietly, that is the rule!

activities.title_en: b for bus, c for car
activities.goal_en: Recognise letter-sounds at the start of travel words.
activities.prompt_en: Listen: b-b-bus. Which letter does bus start with?
steps_en: Show pictures of a bus and a car.
Say each word slowly and stress the first sound.
Show the letter cards b and c.
Match each picture with its letter.
observe_en: Matches the picture with the letter.
Finds another word starting with b.
materials_en: pictures of a bus and a car
source_refs: Nursery One, table 17 (Reading: Letter-sounds), p. 42; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Write the numbers 1 to 5 in order.
activities.prompt_en: Let us write the numbers of the bus seats: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
steps_en: Count 5 chairs as bus seats.
Write each number in the air.
Trace them on a slate or in sand.
Write them on paper, one after the other.
observe_en: Starts each number at the top.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 18 (Writing: Letters and numbers), p. 43; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Si je suis perdu : « Je m’appelle… »
activities.goal_en: Say one’s name and a parent’s name in French in case one is lost.
activities.prompt_en: If you are lost, say to a trusted adult: “Je m’appelle Ayuk. Ma maman s’appelle…”
steps_en: Explain: if you are lost, stay where you are and look for a trusted adult (police, teacher, seller).
Practise “Je m’appelle…”.
Add “Ma maman s’appelle…” or “Mon papa s’appelle…”.
Act the scene with a puppet.
observe_en: Knows to stay and ask a trusted adult.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 19 (French: Se présenter), p. 44; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.prompt_en: How many passengers are in our bus? Let us count.
steps_en: Line up chairs as a bus.
Children sit as passengers.
Count the passengers together.
Change the number and count again.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 20 (Mathematics: Counting), p. 45; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: Count the passengers next to the bus. How many passengers?
interactive.explanation_en: Count each passenger once: there are 6 passengers.

activities.goal_en: Take away and say how many are left, within 10.
activities.prompt_en: There are 8 passengers. At the market, 3 get off. How many stay in the bus?
steps_en: Put 8 toy people or stones in a box (the bus).
Take 3 out: they get off.
Count the passengers left.
Try with other numbers.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 20 (Mathematics: Mathematical operations), p. 45; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Describe day and night and what we see in the sky.
activities.prompt_en: In the day, we see the sun. At night, we see the moon and the stars. When do we sleep?
steps_en: Show pictures of the sky by day and by night.
Name the sun, the moon and the stars.
Sort pictures of activities: day (school, market) / night (sleep).
Talk: when we travel at night, we need lights.
observe_en: Names the sun, the moon, the stars.
Sorts activities into day and night.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 22 (Science and Technology: Astronomy), p. 47–48; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Follow road safety rules and ask an adult to help cross the road.
activities.prompt_en: We cross the road at the zebra crossing, holding an adult’s hand, when the cars have stopped.
steps_en: Draw a road and a zebra crossing on the ground.
Show the traffic light colours: red stop, green go.
Practise: stop, look left and right, hold the adult’s hand, cross.
Walk on the side of the road, not in the middle.
observe_en: Holds the adult’s hand to cross.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 27 (Safety Education: Road safety), p. 53; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Be punctual and get ready on time.
activities.prompt_en: The bus leaves at 7 o’clock. If we are late, the bus goes without us! Let us get ready on time.
steps_en: Tell a short scene: a child is late and misses the bus.
Ask: what should he do next time?
Make a picture list: wake up, wash, dress, eat, go.
Play: get ready quickly before the signal.
observe_en: Says why being on time matters.
Puts the morning steps in order.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 25 (Character Education: Simple etiquettes), p. 51; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Keep rubbish in a bag during a trip and throw it in a bin.
activities.prompt_en: In the bus or the car, we keep our rubbish in a bag and throw it in a bin later.
steps_en: Show a picture of rubbish thrown on the roadside.
Ask: is it good? Why not?
Give a small bag for the rubbish.
At the end of the pretend trip, throw it in the bin.
observe_en: Says not to throw rubbish outside.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 26 (Environmental Education: The environment), p. 52; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Draw a vehicle with rectangles, squares and circles and colour it.
activities.prompt_en: A car is a big rectangle with two circles for the wheels and squares for the windows.
steps_en: Show the shapes: rectangle, square, circle, triangle.
Draw a big rectangle.
Add two circles as wheels and squares as windows.
Colour the car.
observe_en: Places the wheels under the car.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 30 (Drawing and Colouring: Shapes and colouring), p. 56; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Walk while carrying an object in balance.
activities.prompt_en: Travellers carry bags. Walk to the line carrying the bag on your head or in your hands without dropping it.
steps_en: Give a light bag or a small basket.
Walk slowly to a line and back.
Try with the bag on the head, holding it with one hand.
Try along a straight line.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 32 (Physical Education and Sports: Gymnastics), p. 58; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Says “Je m’appelle…” and the name of a parent.
Recognises b for bus and c for car.
Writes the numbers 1 to 5 with help.
Says what we see in the sky by day and by night.
Crosses at the zebra crossing with an adult.
Is on time for a trip.
Walks carrying an object in balance.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery One tables, cited and not reproduced.
